explanation: The downstream priorities all have upstream_rank 0 because the evidence_sources handoff uses source IDs as record_id values, so job_2 cannot match provenance ranks to coverage rows keyed by need record_id. The supplied upstream source shows assemble_provenance constructs evidence_sources with record_id set to record.get('source_id'), changing the record identity instead of preserving the need record_id. This violates the criteria to preserve record_id/source provenance and causes incorrect downstream ranking provenance.
cited_evidence: Job 2 input needs use record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08, while evidence_sources use record_id values s01 through s08.
Observed job_2 priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for every record, indicating no provenance rank matched the coverage record_id values.

assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_weight': record.get('source_weight', 0), 'rank': index}, replacing the demand record_id with source_id.
